content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Dear Client,

I hope you are well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a small amendment before signing:

- The relevant clause states that all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables belong to the client as soon as they are created. This could leave the contractor without leverage to enforce payment if invoices are outstanding. I propose that the rights remain with the contractor until full payment of all invoices has been received, at which point the contractor will assign those rights to the client.

Thank you for your understanding. I look forward to your thoughts.

Kind regards,
